architectureDecisions: Compare raw SHA, binary Git diff, and incremental Git bundle. Prefer a content-addressed external output directory containing a manifest, binary patch for review and a verified incremental bundle when exact commit retention is required.
Use a private transport ref only in a temporary export repository to construct the bundle; do not silently create a source branch or push a PR. Bind base prerequisites explicitly.
Publish atomically before cleanup; exclude prompts and credentials. Packaging is not publication approval or a product-value verdict; SCM bridge remains BB-068.
implementationSlices: S1 — Pin contract/API and execute the discriminating prototype in the research brief; proposed future implementation files are not claimed to exist.
S2 — After fresh READY, implement only the declared seam and focused positive/negative fixtures.
S3 — Run focused regressions, bind independent evidence and reconcile Living descriptions before Worker judgment.
